evidence.text:
Negative-order progress: the Vendi–LCR comparison for every finite q<0 and the directly defined minus-infinity endpoint, on positive spectral support, without a full-rank assumption.See full solutionHide full solutionScope: negative orders on positive spectral support. This submission does not claim a new proof of all nonnegative orders, an analytic order-limit theorem, or a weighted-distribution extension.
For finite positive semidefinite similarity matrices with diagonal one and entries between zero and one, we prove the uniform Vendi–LCR comparison at every negative order using the positive spectral support evidenced in the source implementation. A spectral Jensen argument also proves the directly defined minus-infinity endpoint. Classical Jensen and Holder–McCarthy inequalities and known nonnegative/full-rank cases are credited. No analytic order-limit theorem or weighted-distribution formal extension is claimed.
AI-assisted preprint by Myeongjin Kang, with no affiliation. Internal AI review is not external journal peer review.
